summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: This exchange-traded fund is managed by Tidal Investments LLC and seeks to track the performance of the BITA Global Industrials ex US Select Index. The fund invests in the public equity markets of the global, ex-U.S. region, focusing on growth and value stocks of companies in the industrials sector across various market capitalizations. It utilizes a full replication technique to mirror its underlying index.
